title: Why are prices going up?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Which price increase affects ordinary households most strongly: housing, food, energy, or transport?
Why can prices keep rising even after the original cause of inflation has disappeared?
Should governments control prices of essential goods during periods of very high inflation?
How do rising prices change people's behaviour even before they become financially desperate?
What expense would you cut first if your cost of living suddenly increased by 20 percent?
